The most expensive process in a company is the one nobody owns.

The leave request that lives in WhatsApp. The purchase that gets approved by a phone call. The invoice that waits for someone to "check the file".

Automation here is not robots. It is giving each of those a form, a rule and an approver, so it moves by itself and leaves a record. A PIN approval instead of a call. A document that generates itself from data already in the system. A reminder that fires before the deadline instead of after.

We start with the three processes that cost the most time and build from there.

Changing accounting software is not the risk. Losing your history is.

Most migrations to QuickBooks, Zoho or Odoo move opening balances and start fresh. Then the auditor asks for a 2023 invoice, and it lives in a system nobody can open any more.

We migrate the full history: every invoice, receipt, journal and contact, reconciled against the old trial balance before anyone switches. The old system is closed only when both agree to the fils.

If you are planning a move before the next financial year, the time to plan it is now.

Where is the signed copy?

Every company has the folder, the shared drive and the WhatsApp photo of a contract. Finding the current signed version takes a morning, and nobody is sure it is the latest.

Document control in our systems is simple: one place per document, a version history, a QR code on every PDF that proves it is the real one, and expiry alerts for licences, visas and insurance before they lapse.

It is the least exciting module we build and the one clients thank us for most.

E-invoicing is coming to every UAE business, and most of the work is not the invoice.

From 1 July 2027 businesses under AED 50 million revenue must issue invoices through an accredited service provider, with an ASP appointed by 31 March 2027. Larger companies go first, on 1 January 2027.

We do not provide e-invoicing. What we do is make your system ready for it: the buyer's TRN on every record, the right tax categories, item codes, clean master data, and a connector to the accredited provider you choose, so each invoice is transmitted and its status shows on the document.

If your invoices still come out of Word or Excel, that is the first thing to fix. Free checklist on our website: global-link.ae/tools.html
